scientists.name: Joseph Black
scientists.significance: Separated temperature from thermal quantity; foundation for calorimetry.

scientists.name: Sadi Carnot
scientists.significance: Established roots of a general performance limit; original caloric framework later revised.

scientists.name: James Prescott Joule
scientists.significance: Quantitative experimental support for energy conversion and conservation.

scientists.name: Rudolf Clausius
scientists.significance: Added direction and irreversibility to energy accounting.

scientists.name: William Thomson / Lord Kelvin
scientists.significance: Developed a general temperature framework; original proposal later refined.

scientists.name: James Clerk Maxwell
scientists.significance: Connected particle populations with bulk properties; examined second-law assumptions.

scientists.name: Ludwig Boltzmann
scientists.modern_association: Multiplicity; k_B links energy and K
scientists.significance: Explained thermal regularities through microscopic possibilities.

scientists.name: Max Planck
scientists.significance: Opened quantum theory through the thermal-radiation problem.
